KRAS mutation status is an independent prognostic factor for OS, PFS and response rate in patients with metastatic CRC, but not in the adjuvant setting.

The main takeaway from our work is that
KRAS analysis is a valid predictive marker for cetuximab in patients with chemorefractory CRC.
the predictive value of KRAS is not confined to the primary tumor but also extends to metastatic lesions.
KRAS mutations are not predictive of response to irinotecan-based therapy, but they are associated with a worse outcome in patients treated with irinotecan.
